page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a storage-focused cloud instance configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs from the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor family running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The system is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It operates on a KVM hypervisor platform and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

A defining hardware feature of this instance is its massive array of local HDD storage, offering 47,244 GB of direct-attached capacity. This storage density makes the instance effective for scenarios requiring high-volume capacity on localized spinning disks rather than high-cost solid-state media. By coupling high-capacity magnetic drives with a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the hardware configuration provides high storage efficiency per core, though sequential throughput and IOPS remain bound by HDD mechanics compared to local NVMe SSD solutions.

Given the reliance on extensive HDD storage alongside 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64 GB of RAM, the instance is structured for big data processing, log analytics, distributed file systems, data archiving, and batch ETL pipelines where total storage capacity per node takes priority over ultra-low storage latency.
